title: Horse wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- horse body -->
  <rect x="24" y="48" width="52" height="28" rx="12" fill="#C97A3A"/>
  <!-- horse neck -->
  <rect x="58" y="34" width="16" height="24" rx="6" fill="#D98A4A"/>
  <!-- horse head -->
  <rect x="62" y="22" width="20" height="18" rx="8" fill="#D98A4A"/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <rect x="72" y="30" width="12" height="10" rx="4" fill="#F0B070"/>
  <!-- nostril -->
  <circle cx="80" cy="34" r="1.5" fill="#8A4A1A"/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx="70" cy="27" r="2.5" fill="#2A1A0A"/>
  <circle cx="70.8" cy="26.3" r="1" fill="#E0F0FF"/>
  <!-- ear -->
  <polygon points="64,22 66,14 70,22" fill="#C97A3A"/>
  <!-- mane -->
  <rect x="56" y="16" width="6" height="34" rx="3" fill="#7A3A1A"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="18" r="4" fill="#7A3A1A"/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x="30" y="72" width="8" height="18" rx="3" fill="#B86A2A"/>
  <rect x="42" y="72" width="8" height="18" rx="3" fill="#C97A3A"/>
  <rect x="58" y="72" width="8" height="18" rx="3" fill="#B86A2A"/>
  <rect x="70" y="72" width="8" height="18" rx="3" fill="#C97A3A"/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x="29" y="86" width="10" height="5" rx="2" fill="#5A2A0A"/>
  <rect x="41" y="86" width="10" height="5" rx="2" fill="#5A2A0A"/>
  <rect x="57" y="86" width="10" height="5" rx="2" fill="#5A2A0A"/>
  <rect x="69" y="86" width="10" height="5" rx="2" fill="#5A2A0A"/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M24 52 Q12 46 10 60 Q8 72 18 70" fill="none" stroke="#7A3A1A" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <polygon points="70,22 78,4 86,22" fill="#FF4D7A"/>
  <!-- hat stripes / dots -->
  <circle cx="77" cy="10" r="2" fill="#FFE44D"/>
  <circle cx="80" cy="16" r="2" fill="#4DD2FF"/>
  <circle cx="74" cy="16" r="2" fill="#4DD2FF"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="20" r="1.5" fill="#FFE44D"/>
  <!-- hat pom pom -->
  <circle cx="78" cy="3" r="3" fill="#FFE44D"/>
  <!-- party horn near mouth -->
  <polygon points="84,34 92,30 92,38" fill="#4DD2FF"/>
  <rect x="82" y="33" width="3" height="5" rx="1" fill="#FF4D7A"/>
</svg>
